verdict.rationale: Folk's pricing page lists Dashboards as a first-party feature on a higher tier, alongside pipeline management, so in-app reporting exists without exporting. There is no documentation of what those dashboards cover or how reports are built. missing for 10: documented report/dashboard builder, evidence of pipeline, activity and conversion metrics, conversion/funnel reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can build reports and dashboards on pipeline, activity, and conversion without exporting to a spreadsheet

citations.quote: All in Standard, plus: Custom objects & Deals ... Email sequences ... Workspace roles ... Dashboards ... API access
